reason: A DSH WebUI sidebar plugin for browsing categorized short videos with native playback, direct-stream resolution, autoplay, navigation controls, and playback history.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 侧栏中浏览分类短视频，支持原生播放、直链解析、自动连播、手势导航和历史回放。
summaries.en: Browse categorized short videos in a DSH WebUI sidebar with native playback, direct-link resolution, autoplay, gesture navigation, and playback history.

capabilities: Fetches video metadata and redirect targets from a configured third-party API
Plays direct video streams in a native browser video player
Supports embedding user-configured webpages in an iframe
Stores video URLs for playback history and navigation
